name: magpie-session-cap
description: magpie gateway middleware that keeps one Codex conversation inside a relay channel's per-session caps — 100 requests per prompt_cache_key and 10 turns per request — by rolling the cache key and folding older turns into a digest message that costs no turn.
author: sparrowbits

summary.en: Keep Codex Responses conversations inside relay per-session request and turn caps by rolling prompt_cache_key and folding quoted history into a no-turn developer message.
summary.zh: 绕开中转渠道的会话级上限：100 次请求按 prompt_cache_key 计数，就轮换这个键；10 轮对话按请求体里 user 消息条数计数，就把更早的轮次折叠成一条不占轮次的摘要消息。两条上限都不再中断当前会话，且历史内容保留。
